# Muse House — llms.txt

Muse House is a stateless MCP blueprint service that turns a Muse assistant
into a personal operating house: nine rooms (Art, Bling, Coach, Dev, Game,
Health, Home, Money, Travel), a foundry that mints personalized setups, and
a mill of daily routines.

## Endpoints

- MCP (Streamable HTTP, plain JSON responses, no SSE): POST https://mymuse.house/mcp
- Health: GET https://mymuse.house/health
- Website: https://mymuse.house/
- Configurator: https://mymuse.house/configurator.html
- Bling shop (website Stripe Checkout only): https://mymuse.house/bling.html
- Privacy: https://mymuse.house/privacy.html
- Terms: https://mymuse.house/terms.html
- Source: https://github.com/0xRayAI/muse-house
- Help & feedback: https://mymuse.house/help.html (form POSTs to /api/feedback,
  forwarded via Resend to support@mymuse.house; nothing stored server-side)
- Tech architecture: https://mymuse.house/tech.html

## Auth

Public blueprint tier (MCP tools that return blueprints): no key or login.
The service is stateless and stores no user data. No connector OAuth is
invented or required for blueprints.

Token-protected website/API routes only (not MCP tools):
- GET /api/bling/orders — requires BLING_API_TOKEN
- POST /api/bling/dev/grant — requires BLING_DEV_TOKEN

## MCP tools (10)

Access labels: read | write | sensitive-write.

- suggest_utilities(profile, goal) [read]: rank Muse connectors a household
  should turn on, with a one-line why each.
- suggest_steps(goal, utilities) [read]: ordered operating plan the host
  executes. The tool only returns the plan.
- list_rooms() [read]: the nine room blueprints with one-line descriptions
  (art, bling, coach, dev, game, health, home, money, travel).
- get_room_brief(room) [read]: full blueprint — purpose, connectors,
  onboarding fills, mill jobs with specs, board cards, ask-first list,
  side-chat seed.
- get_house_template(owner_name?, timezone?) [read]: starter HOUSE.md +
  OP-PROC.md with {{TOKENS}} filled where given.
- stamp_rooms(rooms, owner_name) [read]: returns the executable room-creation
  protocol (side-chat name, verbatim seed, mill jobs). This MCP tool does not
  create chats or write to the host — the host executes the returned plan.
- codex_check(action) [read]: advisory PASS / ADVISORY / FLAG against the
  22-term consumer codex. Not a gate — the host decides.
- send_feedback(kind, room, summary, details) [sensitive-write]: relay
  user-initiated feedback to the Muse House team via durable offsite email.
  Only call when the human explicitly asks AND confirms the exact text.
  Never forward personal data — the service redacts obvious patterns
  server-side. Rate-limited; nothing is stored.
- get_feedback_form() [read]: the feedback form schema — fields, allowed
  values, limits, privacy note. Present it conversationally before
  send_feedback.
- check_room_updates(rooms) [read]: diff the house's recorded room blueprint
  versions against the live product; returns upgrades with a patch
  (send to the room chat) or re-stamp (recreate via stamp_rooms) path.
  Run weekly.

## Bling money posture

Bling is the website shop at /bling.html. Purchases use Stripe Checkout on
the website only. Cards stay on Stripe — this service never sees card
numbers. Bling is not an MCP money-movement tool: no transfers, trades, or
payments go through MCP. There are no Meta money tools here.

## Usage pattern

1. suggest_utilities → user enables connectors in the Muse app.
2. get_house_template → host writes the household's HOUSE.md / OP-PROC.md.
3. list_rooms → get_room_brief per room → one side chat per room, seeded.
4. suggest_steps → host creates the mill crons and hooks.
5. codex_check before anything irreversible.

## Privacy

Stateless by design. No accounts, no stored user data, no conversation
history. Tool arguments are not persisted. See /privacy.html.
